Each Euclidean ball satisfies coordinate lower bounds and all clique/odd-hole support-plane constraints, yielding two sharp upper bounds. The uniform center at their minimum attains all constraints, and equality forces uniqueness. The difference between active reciprocal barriers has a strictly decreasing positive rationalized radical expression, crossing exactly t=a^2-2a-1; contact counts and tangential iff classification follow. Standalone exact-object finite LP/rank checks pass for 24 configurations, but are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: The exact largest-ball radius and complete active-facet classification address the intrinsic Euclidean geometry of a natural two-parameter family of stable-set polytopes built from an induced odd hole and a clique. The quadratic integral threshold produces infinitely many distinct nontrivial all-facets-tangent polytopes and separates global odd-hole from local clique controls. These structural contact sets, sharp exact transition and uniqueness are not routine facet-count or lattice-volume facts, and are natural for circumscribability/tangential geometry; no broader theorem is asserted.
